lieu: living room of a modest apartment in Yopougon, Abidjan, a faded green sofa, the front door open on the left, evening

persos.nom: the furious wife with the suitcase
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, long orange-and-purple patterned wrap gown, a big flowered suitcase at her feet
persos.pose: standing by the open front door on the left, hands on her hips, furious

persos.nom: the calm husband on the sofa
persos.desc: husband in his 40s, white undershirt, navy-and-white striped pyjama trousers, holding banknotes
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa, calmly counting his banknotes

dialogue: Je rentre chez ma mère dêh !
Ya fohi. Tiens deux mille pour le woro-woro.
Mais c'est cinq cents seulement !
Prends tes sœurs avec toi.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The wife shouts, hands on her hips. The husband calmly holds out a banknote toward her without getting up. The wife protests, surprised. The husband answers calmly, still holding out the banknote, his face clearly visible.
chute: The wife freezes with her mouth open, staring at the banknote. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the wife's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: small roadside kiosk shop in Abobo, Abidjan, shelves with soap, rice bags and drinks, a skinny brown-and-white dog lying in front of the counter, sunny afternoon

persos.nom: the nervous young man in the bucket hat
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, lime-and-black football shirt with the number 10, a white bucket hat
persos.pose: standing in front of the counter, looking nervously at the dog

persos.nom: the old shopkeeper behind the counter
persos.desc: old shopkeeper in his 60s, grey stubble, mustard-and-brown striped shirt
persos.pose: leaning on the counter behind it, relaxed

persos.nom: the skinny dog
persos.desc: skinny brown-and-white dog lying on the ground
persos.pose: lying in front of the counter, staring at the young man

dialogue: Vieux père, ton chien-là me regarde bizarre. Il mord dêh ?
Non mon vieux. Il mord seulement les gens qui ont l'argent. Toi, passe tranquille.
jeu: Nobody walks; everyone stays in place for the whole video. The dog stays lying on the ground. The young man asks nervously, pointing at the dog. The shopkeeper answers calmly, leaning on the counter, his face clearly visible.
chute: The dog yawns, loses interest and calmly lays its head back down on its paws. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the young man's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: dining table in a middle-class house in Marcory, Abidjan, a thick folder of papers and a calculator on the table, a ceiling fan, evening

persos.nom: the teenage son with the report card
persos.desc: teenage boy around 14, plum-coloured zip-up sweatshirt, holding a report card in one hand
persos.pose: standing next to the table, holding up his report card, confused

persos.nom: the father with the bank folder
persos.desc: father in his 40s, thin glasses, navy office shirt with a red tie, a thick bank folder in front of him
persos.pose: sitting at the table, filling in bank forms with a pen

dialogue: Papa, pourquoi mon bulletin-là est dans ton dossier de prêt ?
Mon fils, la banque veut savoir si je finance un projet sans avenir.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The son asks, holding up his report card. The father answers calmly without stopping writing, his face clearly visible.
chute: The father keeps writing calmly on the bank form. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the son's devastated face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room of a family house in Koumassi, Abidjan, a sofa with white lace covers, a baby cot, afternoon

persos.nom: the loud visiting aunt
persos.desc: loud aunt in her 50s, emerald-green brocade kaba with a matching emerald gele headwrap
persos.pose: standing next to the sofa, leaning over the baby, smiling widely

persos.nom: the young mother holding the baby
persos.desc: young mother in her 20s, soft pink t-shirt dress, holding a baby wrapped in a white blanket; the baby has very big round ears and a big round nose exactly like his father
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa holding the baby, proud

persos.nom: the father with the big ears
persos.desc: father in his 30s with very big round ears and a big round nose, olive-green tracksuit jacket, holding a cup of tea
persos.pose: sitting in an armchair in the right background, smiling proudly

dialogue: Ehh, le bébé-là ressemble trop à son papa dêh !
Merci Tantie, c'est mon bébé d'amour dêh !
Ya fohi. Il va grandir, ça va passer.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The father keeps smiling proudly and silently in the background. The aunt and the mother keep their faces turned three-quarters toward the camera so their moving lips are clearly visible. The aunt speaks loudly with excitement, mouth wide open. Then the mother opens her mouth and thanks her proudly. Then the aunt speaks again, gently patting the mother's shoulder to reassure her.
chute: In the background, the father's proud smile slowly disappears and his tea cup freezes in the air. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: dining room of the wife's parents' house in Bingerville, Abidjan, a Sunday family lunch on the table, framed family photos on the wall, midday

persos.nom: the curious young wife
persos.desc: young wife in her 20s, lemon-yellow off-shoulder dress, gold hoop earrings
persos.pose: sitting at the table next to her husband, turning to him with a curious smile

persos.nom: the stingy husband
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, neat beard, grey linen jacket over a white t-shirt, holding a fork
persos.pose: sitting at the table, eating calmly

persos.nom: the father-in-law at the head of the table
persos.desc: father-in-law in his 60s, white moustache, brown-and-gold kente-patterned kaftan
persos.pose: sitting at the head of the table, eating

dialogue: Chéri, tu as payé ma dot-là combien ?
Trois cent mille, ma chérie.
Seulement ?!
Il a même demandé la monnaie dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. Lively, loud, expressive voices like a real Sunday family argument in Abidjan. The wife asks with a big curious smile. The husband answers proudly and loudly while eating. The wife shouts, outraged. The father-in-law answers calmly without looking up from his plate, his face clearly visible.
chute: The wife slowly turns her head toward her husband. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the husband's busted face looking into the camera, his fork frozen in the air.

lieu: wedding reception hall in Cocody, Abidjan, decorated with white and gold flowers, a tall three-tier white wedding cake on a table behind, a DJ booth with speakers on the right, evening party lights

persos.nom: the aunt with the microphone
persos.desc: aunt in her 50s, shiny gold sequined boubou with a huge gold headwrap, holding a microphone
persos.pose: standing in the middle, holding the microphone up, outraged

persos.nom: the young DJ with the headphones
persos.desc: young DJ in his 20s, neon-green t-shirt with a black lightning bolt, big headphones around his neck
persos.pose: standing behind the DJ booth on the right, one hand on the mixer

dialogue: Pourquoi mon micro-là est coupé ? Je donnais conseils aux mariés dêh !
Tantie, depuis tu parles, même le gâteau-là commence à se séparer.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The aunt shouts at the DJ, shaking the dead microphone, outraged. The DJ answers calmly and points at the wedding cake behind her.
chute: The aunt slowly turns her head toward the wedding cake. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the aunt's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: veranda of a family house in Riviera, Abidjan, wicker chairs, potted plants, late afternoon

persos.nom: the strict father in the wicker armchair
persos.desc: strict father in his 50s, short grey hair, charcoal-grey kaftan with silver embroidery
persos.pose: sitting in a wicker armchair, pointing his finger, strict

persos.nom: the defiant daughter
persos.desc: daughter in her 20s, coral crop top, high-waisted red trousers, braided ponytail
persos.pose: standing in front of her father, arms crossed, defiant

persos.nom: the mother knitting
persos.desc: mother in her 50s, teal-and-white checked kaba dress, knitting with orange wool
persos.pose: sitting in a wicker chair on the right, knitting calmly

dialogue: Ma fille, ton copain-là est pauvre. Laisse-le !
Papa, toi aussi tu étais pauvre quand maman t'a choisi.
Voilà ! Regarde ta mère : elle regrette.
Chaque jour dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The mother keeps knitting calmly. The father gives his order strictly. The daughter answers, defiant. The father points proudly at the mother. The mother answers calmly without looking up from her knitting, her face clearly visible.
chute: The father's proud pointing finger slowly drops. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: small bedroom of a modest house in Anyama, Abidjan, a poster of a footballer on the wall, a bunk bed, evening

persos.nom: the dreaming little boy
persos.desc: little boy around 8, sky-blue pyjamas with little stars, a toy airplane in his hand
persos.pose: sitting on the lower bunk, dreaming, holding his toy airplane up

persos.nom: the father in the doorway
persos.desc: father in his 40s, faded red security-guard uniform shirt, tired eyes
persos.pose: standing in the doorway, leaning on the frame, smiling tenderly

dialogue: Papa, quand je serai grand, je veux être riche comme Tonton Koffi !
Pourquoi pas comme moi ?
Papa, c'est toi-même qui as dit de viser haut dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The boy dreams out loud, raising his toy airplane. The father asks tenderly, a bit hurt. The boy answers innocently, very sure of himself.
chute: The father's tender smile slowly fades. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's hurt face looking into the camera.
